services.name: New to Pilates
services.desc: Whether you're just starting out or have been practicing for years, private and duet sessions offer a chance to refine and deepen your practice. Join us for group classes on the Mat, Reformer, Chair, Tower and CoreAlign. Find flow, strength and mobility in your practice. With a combined 50+ years of teaching experience, Collette Stewart & Scott Anderson are well-known in the Madison area as master teachers of Pilates and Yoga. After a decade running Mound Street Yoga Center and two studios in Blue Mounds, the couple partnered with Susan Watson to open Pilates on Harrison in 2015.
